items.exampleEn: The lawyer meets her clients in a small office downtown.
items.exampleZh: 那位律師在市中心的一間小辦公室和客戶見面。

items.exampleEn: Farmers in the village cooperate to buy seeds at a lower price.
items.exampleZh: 村裡的農民合作，用比較低的價格買種子。

items.exampleEn: The city offers free training for young entrepreneurs.
items.exampleZh: 市政府為年輕創業家提供免費的訓練。

items.exampleEn: The city grew rich through commerce with nearby ports.
items.exampleZh: 這座城市靠著和附近港口的貿易變得富裕。

items.exampleEn: After the merger, the new company had over ten thousand workers.
items.exampleZh: 合併之後，新公司有超過一萬名員工。

items.exampleEn: Selling umbrellas can be very profitable during the rainy season.
items.exampleZh: 在雨季賣傘可能會非常賺錢。

items.exampleEn: The distributor delivers fresh milk to forty shops every morning.
items.exampleZh: 那家經銷商每天早上把鮮奶送到四十家店。

items.sentenceEn: The two banks announced their merger on Friday morning.
items.sentenceZh: 那兩家銀行在星期五早上宣佈合併。

items.audioEn: Our distributor wants a lower price, so we will meet them on Monday to talk about it.
items.audioZh: 我們的經銷商想要更低的價格，所以我們星期一會和他們見面討論。

items.sentenceEn: If both teams cooperate, we can finish the project by Friday.
items.sentenceZh: 如果兩個團隊合作，我們星期五前就能完成這個專案。

items.sentenceEn: Online commerce has changed the way people buy books.
items.sentenceZh: 網路商務改變了人們買書的方式。

items.stemEn: The ____ was unhappy with our design, so we had to start again.
items.stemZh: 客戶對我們的設計不滿意，所以我們只好重新來過。

items.stemEn: The new bus route was not ____, so the company ended it after a year.
items.stemZh: 新的公車路線不賺錢，所以公司一年後就停駛了。

items.passageEn: Five years ago, Nina Chen started a small company that makes natural soap. As a young entrepreneur, she had little money, so she sold her soap online. Online commerce helped her reach customers all over Taiwan, and her business became profitable after only two years. Last year, a large distributor offered to sell her soap in supermarkets, and she agreed. Then a bigger company proposed a merger. Nina said no, because she wanted to keep control of her own brand. Instead, the two companies decided to cooperate on a new line of gift sets. Now Nina plans to recruit five more workers.
items.passageZh: 五年前，Nina Chen 創立了一家做天然肥皂的小公司。身為年輕的創業家，她沒什麼錢，所以她在網路上賣肥皂。網路商務幫助她接觸到全台灣的顧客，她的生意才兩年就開始賺錢。去年，一家大型經銷商提議把她的肥皂賣進超市，她答應了。後來，一家更大的公司提議合併。Nina 拒絕了，因為她想保有自己品牌的控制權。兩家公司反而決定合作推出一系列新的禮盒。現在 Nina 打算再招募五名員工。

options: 她想保有自己品牌的控制權

questions.questionZh: 兩家公司最後決定怎麼做？
options: 合作推出新的禮盒系列

items.promptZh: 她二十五歲就成為一位成功的創業家。
referenceEn: She became a successful entrepreneur at the age of twenty-five.
At twenty-five, she was already a successful entrepreneur.
rubricZh: 「創業家」可寫，例如 entrepreneur 等
「二十五歲時」可寫，例如 at twenty-five、at the age of twenty-five 等
時態合理（例如 became、was 等）

items.promptZh: 兩國的科學家正在合作研究這種罕見的鳥。
referenceEn: Scientists from the two countries are cooperating to study this rare bird.
Scientists from both countries are cooperating on a study of this rare bird.
rubricZh: cooperate 的用法，例如 cooperate to study、cooperate on a study 等
「正在」用進行式（例如 are cooperating 等）
「罕見的鳥」可寫，例如 this rare bird、this rare kind of bird 等
